item.title: Celery Status
item.description: Celery Status is a page that shows whether DefectDojo’s background-task system is working. DefectDojo runs a lot of its work in the background with Celery: scan imports and reimports, deduplication, notifications, and other jobs that should not hold up a web request. Those jobs wait in a queue on the Redis broker until a Celery worker picks them up. When imports look stuck, duplicates are not being closed, or notifications stop arriving, this page tells you whether the broker is up, whether a worker is running, how many tasks are waiting, and which tasks they are.
